_doc: Deploy-local manifest (deploy-hardening Phase 2 / detective net D3). Enumerates files that are FILLED-IN-PLACE on the VPS and MUST survive every `git pull`. Each must be gitignored (so a pull cannot touch it) and present on the live host. The §2a safe-pull drill and `noctus.dev.predeploy_check` (Phase 4) read this to verify nothing deploy-local is tracked or about to be clobbered. Paths are repo-relative. See KB § GUIDES/production-deploy.md § 2a and projects/deploy-hardening-and-dev-isolation/PROJECT.md.

deploy_local_files.reason: cloudflared named-tunnel config; holds the live <TUNNEL_ID> + credentials-file path. Filled on the VPS; a pull must never modify/delete it.
root runtime secrets (Supabase keys, LLM keys). Deploy-local; never tracked.
cloudflared tunnel credentials JSON (<TUNNEL_ID>.json). Secret; generated by `cloudflared tunnel create`; chmod 600; never committed.

invariants: Every deploy_local_files[].path resolves to `git check-ignore` HIT (ignored) — never tracked.
No deploy GUIDE / runbook / script frames `git reset --hard origin` or `git checkout -- <deploy-local>` as a sync step (destructive-command ban, P-net).
